description_en: Queries the playback progress of a video file inserted into a voice call
description_zh: 在语音通话中插播视频文件后，查询视频播放进度
name: QueryVideoPlayProgress

parameters.help_en: The call ID. You can get the CallId from the response parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) API
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number for which you want to query video playback progress
parameters.help_zh: 查询视频播放进度的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: Details about why access was denied

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates that the request succeeded.

For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Data.description_en:
Details of the response.

progress: The current playback duration, in milliseconds.

duration: The total duration of the file.

You can calculate the playback progress percentage by dividing progress by duration
Data.description_zh:
返回结果详情。

progress：当前播放时长，单位毫秒  

duration：文件总时长

播放进度百分比可以通过progress除以duration获得

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded.

true: The call succeeded.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
